recentItems.title: Funeral held in Gaza for two security staff from Doctors Without Borders killed in Israeli strike
recentItems.description:
Doctors Without Borders (MSF) said Saturday it was "devastated and outraged" by the killing of two of its colleagues in an Israeli strike near one of its clinics in Gaza City on Friday night. MSF said the two men worked as watchmen at the clinic, which was clearly marked with the organization's logos and whose coordinates had been shared with the Israeli military. The Israeli military said Saturday it had killed two Hamas militants in Gaza City, without providing evidence. (Production by Wafaa Shurafa)

recentItems.title: Spanish leaders hold final rallies before snap election that could end Sánchez’s eight-year rule
recentItems.description:
Spain is to elect a new government on Sunday in a snap election that could unseat prime minister Pedro Sánchez. On Friday evening, party leaders addressed their supporters at final campaign rallies ahead of the vote.

recentItems.title: How 3D maps might help save forests
recentItems.description:
Scientists have created the largest collection of 3D forest maps, using laser data to reveal tree height and structure across 56 countries. The Global Canopy Atlas, led by University of Bristol researchers, could help scientists better understand carbon storage, biodiversity and how forests respond to climate change, supporting conservation and restoration efforts. (Produced by Mustakim Hasnath.)

recentItems.title: Heavy rain winds down in New Jersey and Delaware after storms
recentItems.description:
Heavy rain over the East Coast is winding down, with power slowly being restored to hundreds of thousands of customers. The storms led to travel disruptions, downed trees and water rescues from New York to Virginia. Wet snow was falling as far south as the Tennessee Valley, while freezing rain moved across northern New England. (AP video shot by Tassanee Vejpongsa, Mingson Lau)

recentItems.title: Ukrainian children return from Russia in an operation mediated by Melania Trump
recentItems.description:
Ukrainian children returned from Russian-occupied territories and Russia, reunited with their mothers and relatives at the northern border on Friday after years of separation, in an operation mediated by US first lady Melania Trump. Nine children and a 29-year-old former resident of a specialised boarding school were brought back to Ukraine. (AP Video shot Vasilisa Stepanenko)

recentItems.title: 'Something new is happening here,' analyst says on the deadlock in New Zealand's election
recentItems.description:
The final vote count in New Zealand’s election published Friday showed neither the right-wing incumbents nor the left-wing opposition bloc won enough seats to form a majority, giving a centrist party new to Parliament the balance of power in deciding the shape of the next government.

recentItems.title: Scientists use drones and poop-sniffing dogs to perform health checks on orcas
recentItems.description:
Using a drone with specially mounted petri dishes and an 11-year-old rescue dog trained to sniff out feces, a team of scientists perform health checks on an endangered orca population in the Salish Sea. (AP Video: Manuel Valdes)
